name: BP IBS Bogor
address: Jl. Cimanggu Permai No.16, Kedung Jaya, Tanah Sareal, Kota Bogor

notes.id: Sekolah berasrama. Uang pangkal dibayar setelah lulus tes; mencakup fasilitas asrama, ekskul, kokurikuler, field trip, outing class, seragam, dan buku paket. SPP mencakup operasional, makan 3x sehari, dan laundry. Biaya pendaftaran mencakup tes dan konsumsi untuk 3 orang.
notes.en: Boarding school. Entry fee is paid after passing the test; covers boarding, extracurriculars, co-curriculars, field trips, outings, uniforms and textbooks. Tuition covers operations, 3 meals a day and laundry. Registration covers the tests and meals for 3 people.

source.title: Rincian Pembiayaan SMP dan SMA BP IBS 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

notes.id: Uang pangkal Rp27.500.000 dari SMP BP IBS; Rp55.000.000 dari luar. SMA Diniyyah daftar ulang Rp7.500.000. SPP mencakup makan 3x sehari dan laundry.
notes.en: Entry fee Rp27,500,000 from BP IBS junior high; Rp55,000,000 from outside. SMA Diniyyah re-registration Rp7,500,000. Tuition includes 3 meals a day and laundry.

source.title: Rincian Pembiayaan SMP dan SMA BP IBS 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

test.id: Psikotes; tes mata pelajaran umum (Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Inggris, Matematika, IPA, Diniyyah); tes baca Al-Qur'an; wawancara calon santri dan orang tua; tes kesehatan.
test.en: Psychological test; general subjects test (Indonesian, English, maths, science, Islamic studies); Quran reading test; student and parent interviews; health check.

source.title: Rincian Pembiayaan SMP dan SMA BP IBS 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

test.id: Psikotes; wawancara santri (Bahasa Arab, baca kitab, hafalan, kepribadian); wawancara orang tua (manhaj); tes literasi Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Inggris, dan numerasi.
test.en: Psychological test; student interview (Arabic, text reading, memorisation, personality); parent interview; Indonesian and English literacy and numeracy tests.

source.title: Rincian Pembiayaan SMP dan SMA BP IBS 2027/2028 (situs resmi)
